claims: KATSEYE made their Coachella debut on April 10, 2026.
KATSEYE performed on the Sahara stage at Coachella 2026.
KATSEYE performed as a five-member group at Coachella 2026.
Manon Bannerman was on a pre-planned health hiatus during KATSEYE's Coachella debut.
KATSEYE's Coachella set included a surprise collaboration with the singers of "HUNTR/X" to perform "Golden" from the KPop Demon Hunters film.
KATSEYE's performance dates at Coachella 2026 were April 10 and April 17, 2026.
KATSEYE's Coachella 2026 performance venue was the Sahara Stage.
KATSEYE performed an 11-song set at Coachella 2026.
The members of KATSEYE present at Coachella 2026 were Daniela Avanzini, Sophia Laforteza, Lara Raj, Megan Skiendiel, and Yoonchae Jeung.
Manon Bannerman continued her temporary hiatus to focus on health, as announced in February 2026.
Manon Bannerman did not appear with KATSEYE at Coachella 2026.
